rubrics.justification: Accurately describes a good-quality expanded Day 5 blastocyst consistent with 3AA, including compact ICM, cohesive TE, and thinning zona; appropriately notes limits of a single static image, though image-specific detail is somewhat general.
Thoroughly integrates age, tubal factor, ovarian response, FSH, endometrium, sperm parameters, BMI/lifestyle, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent: strong morphology supports transfer quality, while age-related aneuploidy appropriately tempers prognosis and explains implantation/live birth estimates.

Recommendations are well aligned with standard IVF practice and Gardner grading interpretation, including single embryo transfer, attention to hydrosalpinx, luteal support, and nuanced discussion of PGT-A at age 38.
Provides clear, practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, hydrosalpinx evaluation, routine support, and structured follow-up if transfer fails.
